mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity (name, club, leader, start_time, end_time, location, description, budget, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{club}, #{leader}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{location}, #{description}, #{budget}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE activity SET name = #{name}, club = #{club}, leader = #{leader}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, location = #{location}, description = #{description}, budget = #{budget}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM activity WHERE start_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
